reviews.title: Where is the original Color Therapy App?
reviews.text: As my iPad required updating, decided to temporarily delete Color Therapy App to make space for the update. I’ve since realised it is no longer available on the Apple Store and tried every avenue to retrieve the colour app but reviewed my subscription and it has updated to the Color Therapy Coloring Number’ which was not purchased, why has this been changed? I am so disappointed with the changes! 🙁🙁

reviews.title: this app makes me so mad
reviews.text:
I HATE that the new coloring pages are only available for a limited time and if you don’t have premium you can’t color it late It makes me so mad i just want to delete the app and find a better one. At this point why is it even called free when you have to get premium just to do anything nice. Please update the app and make it less frustrating. It’s literally called color therapy not color stress! 
😭 and also i looked and every single review that is negative is barely acknowledged! It’s always the same responses. Like is everything about this app ai generated? I don’t even believe that this app is actually made by humans. (I know humans made this using ai not the other way around but still frustrating) please respond. And be genuine. I’m serious about this it’s stressful and i can’t find many coloring apps. If anyone is looking for a better app I suggest Pigment.

reviews.title: Used to be great.
reviews.text: This app used to be so great, and now its not. They used to have a lot of images to color from all categories for free. The tutorial was still on screen even after I had logged into my old account. It would have been nice if it could be turned off in settings . It would be nice if in settings you could choose how you want to color in settings. (Such as picking either paint by number, or freely on your own, or both.) Not only that but they have also started using AI. In the almost TWENTY years this app has been around I would have never expected them to turn to AI garbage, how truly pathetic, and disgusting. They never needed AI before and they certainly don’t need it now. This app used to be truly great, one of my favorite coloring apps even, and now its a husk of its former self.

I have noticed that you have a LOT of witchcraft pictures mixed  with in your  pictures you provide and they pop up a lot during challenges.   I realized you may have one or two Christian faith pictures but they are very rare.  I would prefer not to have witchcraft all over they challenge photos.  
 Also another problem with this site is that I have been blocked twice now!!! And I don’t have a clue as to why!!! There is no support to call so you can only write an email. All they say is I was spamming and you have to wait 2 weeks. But the 1st time ended up being more like 3 weeks. Again. I have no clue as to why !! I haven’t done anything ….. tell me… did I fail to color a seashell the color pink? Is that why I’m blocked ?

reviews.title: Ex-Paying Member
reviews.text:
I’ve have been a paying member for many years. About a year ago I entered a challenge the required pink sea shells.  I made it pink but they wanted you to use the pink palette only. That is not what the challenge said. Even in the challenge it said recommended pink palette. Recommended means there is a choice. Not a requirement!  The took my paying privileges away. 
I contacted them in hopes of discussion. Since I was a paying member and they only allowed me what non paying members were allowed I feel I was entitled to a refund. Don’t know about you, but what do you call it when you pay to use a service and they don’t deliver?  
Recently, I made an honest mistake. I missed a detail in the challenge. My bad. It’s been roughly three weeks and my account is still blocked. 
I challenge you to find their ‘Contact Support” info. You won’t find it in the app. You will have to search Google for it.  The go around I received a snotty unprofessional email from them claiming I still can use the app.  They didn’t even sign their name as to who wrote it. 
It’s the privileges I was paying for. So why bother paying?  So for me… No privileges = Not paying. I have officially cancelled my subscription.  This is bad business people.  
It’s a shame because I did enjoy it.

reviews.title: Done with this app for good.
reviews.text: I have been using this app since my daughter has been born and she will be three years old next month. I made one mistake by submitting an artwork to a challenge that I didn’t want to submit and it had the wrong color text instead of gold text like the challenge was saying I accidentally submitted the one I colored with purple text. For that ONE simple mistake I got blocked by admin. My account had almost 10,000 likes on all my artworks.  I have been messaging, I have been pleading. No one gets back to me. My account was supposed to be blocked for 14 days for a simple mistake here I am almost 30 days later and I still can’t use my account. I mean all of that for one simple mistake for a challenge. I think that’s a bit ridiculous. So after years of using the app and loving the app, I hate it and I deleted it off my phone and I will never download the app again. If you make a mistake on a challenge, they will punish you and it’s a bit ridiculous. I mean to get blocked over a coloring app for a mistake?? WILD. hate this app anymore.

reviews.title: Disappointing colors, AI art
reviews.text: I signed up for the free week, thinking if I really love it maybe it would be worth the pricey subscription. I thought the poor color choices were because I didn’t have the subscription and that would expand the color selection. I was wrong. It’s also AI art, which you will notice as you color. My first tip off? A smiling moon with no eyes, but 2 mouths. Or two eyes in really weird places? Anyway, I was disappointed. :(
